title: Dustin Freeman - Procedurally Generating Technology Trees
speaker: Dustin Freeman
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Dustin Freeman gets lost in tech trees all the time. By day, he builds new embodiment technology at Facebook Reality Labs. By night, he works on telepresence LARPs. He's Canadian, but lives in New York. 

Speculative fiction often postulates an alternate technology tree from ours, due to a different culture, or available resources, or even alternate physics. On the other hand, most games, proc gen or otherwise, treat technology trees as fixed. There are rare exceptions. This lighting talk will talk about Dustin's search to procedurally generate technology trees in a meaningful way.

Find him on Twitter: https://twitter.com/dustinfreeman
